svg.title: wa-bills
svg.desc: Two bill texts, the nearer cut clear of the one behind it, lines of text cut out: Washington legislation as a corpus. It stands on the detached base bar that marks the Washington public-record stores. Drawn in one ink on the budget-drs app icon's box and rules, for the page to paint in its text colour: solid, no strokes, and every gap at least 2.5 units, which is about 1.4 CSS pixels at 16.
